light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a helper with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the workroom background stays fully readable. The only light is the daylight from the tall window on the left plus the ceiling light; correctly exposed. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores, age spots and uneven tone; hair with stray strands; clothes with real creases. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld video filmed by a helper with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural older hands; she moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

anchors.prompt: Same workroom, same moment of the day. Hazel, a 69-year-old woman with grey hair loosely pulled back with a few stray strands, thin wire-rimmed reading glasses, small silver drop earrings, a faded blue denim button-up shirt with the sleeves rolled up to the forearms, natural older skin with lines and age spots sits at the worn wooden worktable of her appraisal workroom: white painted board walls, a tall window on the left, a dark wood china cabinet and an old dresser, open shelves with silver teapots and old jewelry boxes behind her, a white magnifier lamp on a swing arm, a pair of white cotton gloves on the worn wooden worktable. She holds up a heavy round sparkling cut glass bowl deeply cut with stars and diamonds, a small round white $5 price sticker on its rim in both hands toward the camera and talks to the camera, eyebrows raised, warm and direct. Medium shot, her upper body and the table in frame. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

A few seconds later, same place: she holds the cut glass bowl in one hand and has just run her other thumb along its sharp rim; she shakes that thumb in the air with a wince and a dry little laugh, looking at the camera. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

Same place a few seconds later: she holds the cut glass bowl up beside her face and gives the camera a knowing look over the top of her glasses. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

Same place a few seconds later: she sets the cut glass bowl down on the worktable in front of the camera and leans in over it on her forearms, a conspiratorial half smile. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

Same place a few seconds later: still leaning over the bowl, she raises one finger and opens her eyes wide, about to say a number. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

clips.text: Five dollars. That's what was written on the little sticker.
clips.action: She holds the cut glass bowl up toward the camera and taps the little price sticker on its rim while she talks. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

clips.text: I ran my thumb along the edge, and it bit me.
clips.action: She runs her thumb along the sharp rim of the bowl, winces and shakes her thumb, then gives a dry little smile, talking to the camera. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.

clips.text: A name. That bowl went to auction
clips.action: She leans over the bowl on the table and raises one finger, eyes widening, talking to the camera as if sharing a secret. She wears the same faded blue denim shirt with rolled-up sleeves, the same thin wire-rimmed reading glasses and small silver drop earrings, grey hair loosely pulled back.
